title: RBI Imposes Penalties on Bank of Baroda and GIC Housing Finance for Regulatory Non-Compliance
description: <cite index="15-3,15-4,15-5">The RBI imposed a total penalty of Rs. 66.7 lakh on Bank of Baroda and GIC Housing Finance. Bank of Baroda was fined Rs. 63.6 lakh for non-compliance with Fair Practices Code for Lenders and KYC guidelines.</cite>
